recipes.name: Cheesy Potatoes with Smoked Sausage
ingredients_raw: 1 (1 pound) package Hillshire Farm® Smoked Sausage
1 (20 ounce) package refrigerated shredded hash brown potatoes

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly spray a 13x9-inch baking pan with a non-stick cooking spray. Cut sausage into 1/2-inch cubes. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl.
Spread mixture evenly in the prepared pan. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until lightly browned. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

raw_recipe.headline: Cheesy Potatoes with Smoked Sausage
raw_recipe.description: Meat and potatoes, a time-tested, delicious combination that everyone loves. Hillshire Farm Smoked Sausage with potatoes and melted cheese served with sour cream and onion. In other words: delicious.

review.reviewBody: My kids LOVED IT!!! Next time I might try softened cream cheese instead of sour cream.

This was delicious and easy! I was on a mission to use food I already had on hand and this worked great! Others had suggested sour cream or soups which would definitely work. I had a full package of frozen breakfast potatoes, 1/2 cup of sour cream, 1/2 block of cream cheese, 1/2 stick of butter, 1 half onion, and full Hillshire sausage. I added in a dash of hot mustard, a few drops of Frank's got sauce, onion salt, and a dash of worcestershire. You could easily add more veggies to this to make it more healthy.

I really enjoyed this. I subbed smoked turkey sausage, light sour cream, and omitted the butter. Saved a bunch of calories and it was still delicious! I used thawed frozen hashbrowns and it worked just fine. Will make again.

This was an amazing recipe! I wanted to try something besides just frying up the sausage, and I am glad I did! I have also tried it with tater tots instead of hashbrowns, and that is good too! We also found that adding hotsauce and mustard gives it a little kick.

I used some of the ideas from other reviewers. I used potatoes O’Brien and added a can of Campbell’s cheddar soup. After cooking for a half hour I sprinkled more cheddar cheese on top and baked for 15 more minutes.
A couple of comments sounded like some people wanted more flavor. Just cut the sour cream in half and add a can of cream of mushroom soup. It makes this recipe pop!

I thought it was very good and super simple and easy to make..I used shredded Simply Potatoes southwestern style potatoes and a purple onion..It was easier to mix everything together when you put it in a bigger mixing bowl then transfer it to a 13x9 baking pan..I was a little heavy handed on the pepper, I didn't measure that to be honest. It was other wise a good recipe that will definately get use again in my house because we had none left..so certainly that means it was good and a crowd pleaser!
Easy recipe and very good! One of our favorites!! I use the Simply Potatoes hash browns and add an over easy egg to each serving. Delicious!
Only change I made was shred my own potatoes and used Kroger brand sour cream with chives. Fantastic meal—my husband wants it again!
Both my husband and I really liked this recipe! I used turkey smoke sausage and Garlic & Herb hashbrowns. It was very good served with garlic bread.
My entire family loved this meal! I added cream of mushroom soup and it tasted amazing !
So easy! I added a can of cream of potato. Everyone liked this recipe!
I used frozen southern style hashbrowns because that’s what I had on hand but think it wouldn’t have been as good with shredded hashbrowns. Otherwise, it just like I said it came out perfectly
So delicious!
So easy to prepare and bake. On those days where I really don't feel like getting to involved in a laborious dinner meal, this is perfect. Peter Q

I used fresh potatoes that I shredded, since I didn’t have any frozen. This made the texture of the potatoes a little weird because they were shredded to thin. My husband loved it but the rest of the family wasn’t impressed. I will try again with frozen potatoes. Overall it is an easy dinner and something different during a busy week.
My husband and I are really happy with this dish. It is very tasty and easy to make. This is a go to recipe especially if you want a quick good meal that doesn't take much to prepare it.
very tasty

I made this exactly as written. It was delicious. Good, uncomplicated comfort food at its best. I served it with steamed broccoli just to add some green.! I will make this again and again. Thanks for the recipe.

This is a great basic recipe that can be altered 16 ways to Sunday if you’re not afraid of that. I don’t think I have ever made a recipe the same way but there are so many good ideas from cooks here that like to explore options. I’m making this with some leftover packets of Horsey Sauce from Arby’s. Just tell me that a little horseradish sauce added don’t sound good with smoked sausage and, yes, I’m going with hash browns and cream of celery soup. Love, love, love good cooks that can wing it!
